description: The bar chart compares inference times (in minutes) for two large language models — Marco-o1-7B and QwQ-32B-Preview — under five different fine-tuning or prompting strategies: Baseline (light green), Fast-Solving Prompt (yellow), SFT (gray), DPO (orange), and O1-Pruner (blue). In the Marco-o1-7B chart, inference times range from approximately 1.1 minutes (O1-Pruner) to 2.2 minutes (Baseline), with Fast-Solving Prompt and SFT both around 2.1 minutes, and DPO at about 1.5 minutes. In the QwQ-32B-Preview chart, inference times are longer overall, ranging from about 4.0 minutes (O1-Pruner) to 6.2 minutes (Baseline), with Fast-Solving Prompt at ~5.0 minutes, SFT at ~5.8 minutes, and DPO at ~5.5 minutes. Both charts show that O1-Pruner consistently achieves the lowest inference time, while Baseline is the slowest. The bars are grouped by model, with each group containing five stacked horizontal bars representing the different methods, and the x-axis is scaled linearly from 0 to 2.5 for Marco-o1-7B and 0 to 7 for QwQ-32B-Preview. The legend at the bottom identifies each method by color, and the chart visually emphasizes the efficiency gain of O1-Pruner over other methods, particularly in the larger QwQ-32B-Preview model.
